lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Guided practice: safety and supervision planning

standardsRefs: Ready for Life v1, Grade 4 Unit 6: Family Contribution Capstone
Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice safety and supervision planning. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: Using the plan you built in the previous lesson, you now check it for safety before the carry-out day.
materials: learner-local: paper or a notes app

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Explain how checking your plan for supervision needs before the carry-out day changes how ready you feel to actually do it.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Risk identification accuracy: Every step is reviewed and accurately marked as no-supervision, adult-nearby, or adult-handles-directly based on what the step actually involves. | Supervision specificity: Every supervision-needed step lists a specific risk and a specific thing the learner will ask the adult to check or do. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner ask the adult who will supervise to review the plan and add one supervision point the learner missed, then compare it to their own list and note the difference.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can practice safety and supervision planning. I will do one step at a time and check one result.

duration.sessionPattern: 5 minutes model, 5–7 minutes guided try, 10–15 minutes learner task, 5 minutes evidence and retry check
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

localMaterials.label: paper or a notes app
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: safety and supervision planning worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: Using the plan you built in the previous lesson, you now check it for safety before the carry-out day.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact safety and supervision planning decision or action.
Model move 2: Reread your ordered plan step by step before marking anything.

Model move 3: Go through every step in your plan and mark whether it needs no supervision, an adult nearby, or an adult doing that part directly, such as handling a tool, appliance, or cleaning product.

Model check: Risk identification accuracy: Every step is reviewed and accurately marked as no-supervision, adult-nearby, or adult-handles-directly based on what the step actually involves. | Supervision specificity: Every supervision-needed step lists a specific risk and a specific thing the learner will ask the adult to check or do.

resources.title: safety and supervision planning action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for safety and supervision planning.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: safety and supervision planning coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: Using the plan you built in the previous lesson, you now check it for safety before the carry-out day.
Coach direction: Reread your ordered plan step by step before marking anything.
Learner prompt: Name one step in your plan that you are fully confident you can do without any adult help.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: safety and supervision planning complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Go through every step in your plan and mark whether it needs no supervision, an adult nearby, or an adult doing that part directly, such as handling a tool, appliance, or cleaning product.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I reviewed every step in my plan, not just the ones that seemed risky at first glance.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I marked each step as no-supervision, adult-nearby, or adult-handles-directly.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I did not mark a step 'no supervision' just because it seemed easy or familiar.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: safety and supervision planning minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Explain how checking your plan for supervision needs before the carry-out day changes how ready you feel to actually do it.

Success checks: Risk identification accuracy: Every step is reviewed and accurately marked as no-supervision, adult-nearby, or adult-handles-directly based on what the step actually involves. | Supervision specificity: Every supervision-needed step lists a specific risk and a specific thing the learner will ask the adult to check or do.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: safety and supervision planning supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional safety and supervision planning condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Risk identification accuracy: Every step is reviewed and accurately marked as no-supervision, adult-nearby, or adult-handles-directly based on what the step actually involves. | Supervision specificity: Every supervision-needed step lists a specific risk and a specific thing the learner will ask the adult to check or do..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

resources.title: safety and supervision planning delivered plan
resources.purpose: Resolves the lesson's named plan so the learner is never directed to a phantom material.
content: Starting information: Using the plan you built in the previous lesson, you now check it for safety before the carry-out day.
Use steps: Go through every step in your plan and mark whether it needs no supervision, an adult nearby, or an adult doing that part directly, such as handling a tool, appliance, or cleaning product.
Field 1 (t2-p1): I reviewed every step in my plan, not just the ones that seemed risky at first glance.
Field 2 (t2-p2): I marked each step as no-supervision, adult-nearby, or adult-handles-directly.
Field 3 (t2-p3): I did not mark a step 'no supervision' just because it seemed easy or familiar.

Check against: Risk identification accuracy: Every step is reviewed and accurately marked as no-supervision, adult-nearby, or adult-handles-directly based on what the step actually involves. | Supervision specificity: Every supervision-needed step lists a specific risk and a specific thing the learner will ask the adult to check or do.

guidedFirstAttempt.setup: Using the plan you built in the previous lesson, you now check it for safety before the carry-out day.
guidedFirstAttempt.prompt: Name one step in your plan that you are fully confident you can do without any adult help.
coachMoves: Ask the learner to name the condition.
Point to one model step only.
Give feedback against one observable success check.
guidedFirstAttempt.successCondition: Risk identification accuracy: Every step is reviewed and accurately marked as no-supervision, adult-nearby, or adult-handles-directly based on what the step actually involves.
guidedFirstAttempt.correctionTurn: Use the fresh condition on swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-guided-card: change one constraint, redo only the affected move, and state why the corrected move now meets the success check.

simulationRoute.title: safety and supervision planning — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: Complete the safety and supervision planning task using the fictional condition and invented, non-sensitive details on the delivered independent card.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

learnerEvidence: one revision when a step changed
evidence.reflectionPrompt: Explain how checking your plan for supervision needs before the carry-out day changes how ready you feel to actually do it.
observableCriteria: Risk identification accuracy: Every step is reviewed and accurately marked as no-supervision, adult-nearby, or adult-handles-directly based on what the step actually involves.
Supervision specificity: Every supervision-needed step lists a specific risk and a specific thing the learner will ask the adult to check or do.

account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Risk identification accuracy: Every step is reviewed and accurately marked as no-supervision, adult-nearby, or adult-handles-directly based on what the step actually involves. | Supervision specificity: Every supervision-needed step lists a specific risk and a specific thing the learner will ask the adult to check or do.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g4-u06-l03-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
